lines: How much is it worth, I wonder?
This world I'm living in right now
Everything seems meaningless
Maybe I'm just a little worn out
In exchange for what I've gained
So many shining things I've cast aside
I don't have the luxury
To grieve over each one — the world isn't that peaceful
What kind of ideal am I supposed to picture?
What kind of hope should I carry as I go on?
That unanswerable question gets buried in the everyday
If you were here, what would you say, I wonder
Would you tease me, laughing, "how gloomy"
If I could touch that gentle smile of yours
I wish my melancholy would blow away
Even if it's a light like fireworks
That can never be caught
One more time, one more time
One more time, one more time
I want to reach out my hand
Everyone carries their sorrow
But still they wish for a wonderful tomorrow
Blown by the winds of cowardice
This world stirred up with waves and storms —
How much could I love it?
I overthink and the words get stuck
I hate how clumsy I am
But I hate how strangely smoothly I carry myself even more
Whether I spend the time laughing or crying, it flows by all the same
The future is calling us
Can you hear that voice now, too?
Even if I knew from the start
That goodbye would come to meet me
One more time, one more time
One more time, one more time
However many times, I want to meet you again
That we met at all — that because of it
The world could look this beautiful
I never even imagined it
Will you laugh and call it simple?
I'll say thank you to you from my heart
So it never stagnates — swaying, flowing on
If only I could keep a heart like water, growing clear
Enough to cover all the times I'll long to meet you
Enough to cover all the times I'm lonely
One more time, one more time
One more time, one more time
I want to burn you into me, deep
Everyone has their problems
But still they wish for a wonderful tomorrow
Blown by the winds of cowardice
This world stirred up with waves and storms —
How much could I love it?
One more time, one more time
One more time, one more time
